entries.text: Look at you, buddy! Way to go![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_01

entries.text: Guess we got a new BB League Champion![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_02

entries.text: The academy’s got a prize for people like you\nwho make it all the way to being Champion.\r\nHere—all yours.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_03

entries.text: Hey. Kieran.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_04

entries.text: This may not mean much coming from a guy who\ncouldn’t beat you, but...[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_05

entries.text: I wish you’d go back to having fun with all this.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_06

entries.text: I get that burning desire to win. I mean, who\ndoesn’t like winning?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_07

entries.text: Just...don’t let that desire burn you to a crisp.\nIt’s hard to watch.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_08

entries.text: C’mon. Let’s all go and—[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_09

entries.text: *mumble mumble*\n...win...next time...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_brother_01

entries.text: Come again?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_10

entries.text: I won’t lose... Next time, for sure, I’ll...I’ll win.\nNext time...I’ll win...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.text: Whoof.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

[VAR 0x0100(0000)]

congratulations
for

Champion.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.text: It really is an amazing achievement! Something\nthat should be celebrated...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.text:
But with the way things are now, I’m sorry to say
that it does, well...complicate matters.\c
We’re having a bit of a hard time knowing how
we ought to proceed...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.text: Proceed with what?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.text: Well, think about it a moment, would you?![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.text: And of course, if Kieran rejoins the Elite Four\nafter having lost the rank of Champion, that\r\nwould push Crispin out of our ranks.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
